notes: The box flaps. Same kraft family as `cardboard` and the same v2 correction — the flaps are most of the kart's screen area in every capture, so they were carrying most of the amoeba camouflage the critique measured. Held about a stop below the body so the open rim still reads as a rim: the flaps splay out past the silhouette and need a value break against the deck, not just an outline. brushScale is a little finer than the body's (2.2 against 2.6) so the two do not mottle in lockstep, but both sit below the LOD ladder's floor and are therefore world-locked rather than screen-locked. The corrugated cut along the free edge is geometry — see `flapGeometry` in src/vehicle/box.ts. Brush overlay reduced 0.2 -> 0.18: the painterly direction is abandoned (ART_BIBLE 1) and this was still running at full strength, which is the camouflage mottle on terrain.
